newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTOR RACING-WILLIAMS DRIVERS GIVEN SUSPENDED BAN.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-WILLIAMS DRIVERS GIVEN SUSPENDED BAN.

text.p: Williams drivers Jacques Villeneuve and Heinz-Harald Frentzen were each given a one-race ban, suspended for two races, on Saturday for failing to respond to yellow caution flags waved at them during the qualifying session for Sunday's San Marino Grand Prix.

Canada's Villeneuve, who leads the world drivers' championship, had dominated the session and seized his fourth successive pole position this year, narrowly ahead of German team mate Frentzen. They will share the front row of the grid for Sunday's 62-lap race.
